inspect: A biscuit tin. BISCUITS, it says on the lid, and underneath, in Jim's hand: NOT FOR G.
There were thirty. Jim counted them this morning, out loud, looking at one particular person. There are nineteen.
The ship's costume trunk, from the days when the crew did a play every Midsummer. It's covered in stickers from ports that don't exist any more.
The costume trunk, open. Feathers, a scarf, a wooden sword, a moth that has seen things. Something helmet-shaped is missing.
Salty Jim's pantry: two crates, a padlock, and a sign that says JIM'S. Under that, smaller: NOT YOURS. Under that, smaller still: NOT HIS EITHER.
The crate the Grand Crown is locked in. NOT IN BED, it says, in chalk. A fork tine sticks out through the lid, glinting.
